paper_record.title: Transformation of vector modes by the Faraday effect in strong magnetic fields
paper_record.abstract: Large Faraday rotations can be generated by circular birefringence of atomic samples in an axial magnetic field in the vicinity of atomic resonance lines. The Faraday angle is a function of the magnetic field strength, the optical density of the atomic sample which may be varied by changing the temperature of the atomic gas, and of course the optical detuning from the transition frequencies. More generally, magneto-optical effects in atomic samples include circular dichroism in addition to birefringence, resulting in a modification of the ellipticity as well as the polarisation alignment. Usually such effects are investigated for homogeneous linear polarisations, but the mechanisms apply also to polarisation structures such as vector vortices. We investigate the effect of optical activity of a rubidium vapour in the Hyperfine Paschen-Back regime, for the example of an azimuthally polarised input light beam. We show that for low atomic densities, circular birefringence dominates over dichroism, and azimuthal polarisation is rotated towards radial polarisation. The rotation angle increases with increasing optical densities. At high vapour temperatures, dichroism becomes more and more relevant, leading to intricate variations of both alignment and ellipticity.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文研究了强磁场超精细帕申-巴克机制下，铷原子蒸气的法拉第效应对矢量光场偏振模式的调制与转换。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper investigates the transformation of vector light modes by the Faraday effect in a rubidium vapor under the strong-field hyperfine Paschen-Back regime.

problem.zh: 探索在强磁场（超精细帕申-巴克机制）下，原子蒸气的圆双折射与圆二色性如何共同作用并调制空间非均匀偏振的矢量光束。
problem.en: Exploring how the circular birefringence and circular dichroism of an atomic vapor under a strong magnetic field (hyperfine Paschen-Back regime) collectively transform vector beams with spatially varying polarization.

approach.zh: 将方位角偏振的矢量光束聚焦通入处于1.6特斯拉磁场中的铷原子蒸气室，通过改变温度调节原子密度，并利用空间分辨斯托克斯断层扫描技术重建输出光场的偏振态。
approach.en: Focusing an azimuthally polarized vector beam through a rubidium vapor cell in a 1.6 T magnetic field, tuning atomic density via temperature, and reconstructing the output polarization profiles using spatially resolved Stokes tomography.

main_takeaway.zh: 在低原子密度下，圆双折射主导并将方位偏振旋转为径向偏振；在高原子密度下，圆二色性导致特定圆偏振分量被完全吸收，使光束在吸收峰之间经历完整的法拉第旋转循环。
main_takeaway.en: At low atomic densities, circular birefringence dominates and rotates azimuthal polarization toward radial; at high densities, circular dichroism fully absorbs one circular component, causing the beam to undergo full Faraday rotation cycles between absorption dips.

why_it_matters.zh: 展示了一种利用强磁场和温度精确控制矢量光场空间偏振结构的方法，在空间模式控制、光开关和量子传感领域具有应用前景。
why_it_matters.en: It demonstrates a method to precisely control the spatial polarization structure of vector light using strong magnetic fields and temperature, promising for spatial mode control, optical switching, and quantum sensing.

reason.zh: 详细阐明了强磁场下原子蒸气的双折射与二色性对矢量光束偏振态演化的协同影响机制。
reason.en: It details the collaborative mechanism of birefringence and dichroism in atomic vapors under strong magnetic fields on the polarization evolution of vector beams.

reason.zh: 该研究关注原子物理与现代光学（矢量光场）的交叉，非常符合该期刊的收录范围。
reason.en: The study focuses on the intersection of atomic physics and modern optics (vector light fields), which fits well within the scope of the journal.
